chunks: Yūnus, from ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān, who said:
I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh (عليه السلام) saying:
Indeed, among the major sins are disobedience to one's parents, despair of the mercy of Allah, and feeling secure from the plan of Allah.
And it has been narrated that the greatest of the major sins is shirk with Allah.

key_terms.الْأَمْنَ: feeling secure or safe from punishment
key_terms.الْكَبَائِرِ: the major sins, meaning the gravest categories of disobedience
key_terms.الْيَأْسَ: despair, loss of hope in divine mercy
key_terms.رَوْحِ اللَّهِ: the relief, mercy, and comforting aid of Allah
key_terms.عُقُوقَ: undutifulness or disobedience, especially toward one's parents
key_terms.مَكْرِ اللَّهِ: the plan of Allah, from which one must not feel secure

ai.seo_question: What are some of the major sins mentioned by Imam al-Ṣādiq (عليه السلام) in al-Kāfī?
ai.summary: This hadith identifies several of the major sins: undutifulness toward parents, despair of Allah's mercy, and feeling safe from Allah's plan. It also reports that the gravest of all major sins is shirk with Allah, placing moral conduct and correct belief together within the framework of major transgressions.

en.hubeali: Yunus, from Abdullah Bin Sinan who said,
‘From the major sins are – disloyalty to the parents, and the despair from the Spirit (Assistance) of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and the sercurity from the Plan of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’.
And it has been reported that the biggest of the major sins is the association (Shirk) with Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 4. Yunus has narrated from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “
Of the major sins are disregard of good relation with parents, despair for the mercy of Allah, feeling safe from the punishment of Allah
and it is narrated that the biggest of the major sins is to consider things as partners of Allah.’”
